name: form
summary: A native <form> whose errors are shown in the page instead of the browser's bubbles. On submit the runtime checks every control (the constraints you write: required, type, min, pattern…), writes each message under its Field, lists them in a summary at the top with links to the controls, and moves focus to the summary. Fixing a control clears its message. Without the runtime the browser's own validation still runs.
use: Any form with more than one or two fields
Forms where several errors can happen at once

enhances.fallback: the browser's validation bubbles, one at a time

parts.description: The <form>. Put Fields with their controls inside; onSubmit runs only when every control is valid.

summaryTitle.default: 入力内容を確認してください

rules: Put every control in a Field with an id, so its message has a place and the summary can link to it.
Write the constraints on the controls (required, type, min, maxLength, pattern); call setCustomValidity for rules the browser cannot check.
Errors from the server go in Field's error prop; they are shown as they are.

examples.title: Sign up
examples.code:
<Form onSubmit={save}>
  <Field id="signup-email" label="メールアドレス" required><Input type="email" /></Field>
  <Field id="signup-age" label="年齢"><Input type="number" min={18} /></Field>
  <Button type="submit" variant="primary">登録する</Button>
</Form>
